content: Krishna Das inquired about the status of his life policy LP-001234. Anjali Desai informed him that the policy is currently in pending status and requires a proof of income and a medical certificate for activation. Krishna asked for the portal upload link and Anjali's email address to submit the documents.

Provide agent email address to the customer
